style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 70cm Pre Lit Christmas Joy Swag
style.toneOfVoice: A gorgeous spray of faux pines, leaves and berries in rich tones of burgundy and green are gathered on a natural twig base, for a luxurious and joyous Christmas statement. Pinecones and 20 warm white LEDs are dotted throughout, and a large velvet bow is set in the centre for a truly lavish seasonal note. This swag is so easily styled on doors and walls, and creates a beautiful focal point. To illuminate, simply insert 2 x AA batteries into the attached battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the optional 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Pair your swag with the matching "Christmas Joy" foliage range to take your styling to the next level. Height: 700mm. Width: 700mm. Depth: 700mm.
